title: Interval intersection
statementMd:
`a` and `b` are lists of closed, pairwise disjoint, sorted intervals. Return their intersections as a sorted list.

**Example:** `interval_intersection([[0, 2], [5, 10]], [[1, 5], [8, 12]])` returns `[[1, 2], [5, 5], [8, 10]]`.
hints: Two pointers; advance the one ending first.
